taxon_or_group_scope: Atlantic reef fishes sampled on NCRMP/RVC stationary plots
region_scope: Florida Keys reef tract (survey domain years on disk)
testable_claim: Within the Florida Keys RVC frame, detection probability for a named reef species code rises or falls across surveyed depth bins after holding habitat code and visibility; test on spatial blocks and the designated holdout year only.
evidence_basis: Mechanism is standard for reef visual surveys; no FishAI depth-bin behavior test filed in this folder.
notes: Do not pool Puerto Rico/USVI/FGB without a protocol bridge. Not a species-wide law.

taxon_or_group_scope: Atlantic reef fishes on RVC plots
testable_claim: Holding depth and habitat code fixed, lower underwater visibility associates with lower detection rates for visually cryptic reef taxa in the Keys RVC frame.
evidence_basis: Visibility is recorded on retained RVC events and used as a baseline covariate; a dedicated visibility-behavior contrast is not claimed here.
notes: Detection process vs abundance must stay separated.

taxon_or_group_scope: Hard-bottom associated reef fishes on RVC plots
region_scope: Florida Keys and Puerto Rico RVC domains separately
testable_claim: Within one region at a time, detection rates are higher on hard-bottom habitat codes than on soft-bottom codes for reef-associated species codes that list hard-bottom in their ecology notes.
evidence_basis: Habitat codes exist on survey tables; rugosity grids are not acquired.
notes: Test per region; do not copy Keys coefficients to Puerto Rico without a bridge.

testable_claim: In the Flower Garden Banks RVC holdout design, coral or hard-bottom habitat codes predict higher detection than non-coral codes for coral-associated species codes present in that year’s species list.
evidence_basis: FGB events exist on disk; environmental joins absent; no behavior-specific test filed.
notes: Small holdout event counts elsewhere in audit notes; do not invent n.

region_scope: oceanic mesopelagic layer (no FishAI survey frame yet)
testable_claim: Many mesopelagic fish groups perform diel vertical migration (deeper by day shallower by night) in ocean regions where the pattern is documented; FishAI has no mesopelagic effort frame to estimate DVM amplitudes here.
evidence_basis: Well-known ecological pattern for the mesopelagic fish guild; not verified against any FishAI table.
notes: No DOI fabricated. Do not encode into a fitted model. No species-level generalization without a scoped frame.

taxon_or_group_scope: Mesopelagic fishes near oxygen minimum zones
region_scope: eastern tropical Pacific OMZ regions (example geography; not in repo)
testable_claim: Within a named OMZ region, daytime depth of mesopelagic acoustic backscatter or net samples tracks oxygen gradients more than skin SST.
evidence_basis: Reported pattern class for OMZ-associated mesopelagic communities; no OMZ product or acoustic table in this repo.
notes: Source fields not acquired in this repo. Hypothesis only.

region_scope: US continental shelf soft-bottom strata (candidate NEFSC-class frame; not ingested)
testable_claim: For a named soft-bottom demersal stock and survey stratum set, detection or CPUE anomalies associate with near-bottom temperature anomalies more than with analysed SST at the same horizontal cell.
evidence_basis: Demersal mechanism catalogued in WS44; NEFSC-class tables are not fetched here.
notes: Do not invent tow counts. Bottom temperature not acquired.

region_scope: US West Coast rocky reef / nearshore rocky habitat (candidate; not ingested)
testable_claim: Within a West Coast rocky demersal survey frame, low dissolved oxygen at depth reduces detection or CPUE on rocky substrate more than salinity does.
evidence_basis: Guild emphasis from WS44; WCOFS and oxygen archives not acquired.
notes: WCOFS not subset in this repo.

region_scope: California Current coastal domain (CalCOFI/CUFES candidate; CUFES sample on disk is eggs not live fish map)
testable_claim: For a named coastal pelagic egg or larva product in a named cruise set, encounter rates associate with local SST or frontal indicators after effort standardization — without claiming adult school locations.
evidence_basis: CUFES cruise 202204 noted in project status as egg survey AUTO_ACQUIRE_INTERNAL_ONLY; not a live fish map. WCOFS not joined.
notes: Do not generalize egg patterns to adult species distribution.

region_scope: open-ocean frontal regions (no FishAI oceanic effort frame)
testable_claim: For a named oceanic pelagic stock with effort-aware catches or surveys, catch rates elevate near SSH/current frontal features relative to adjacent water of similar SST.
evidence_basis: Pattern class often discussed for pelagics; no RTOFS/WCOFS grid in repo (RTOFS search 404).

evidence_basis: Candidate source family noted in audits; extract not opened.

testable_claim: For one named diadromous stock and river entry, migration or entry counts increase within a documented discharge and salinity window relative to outside that window in the same season.
evidence_basis: Standard diadromous mechanism class; no discharge product acquired here.

testable_claim: Detection rates are higher inside mapped seagrass cover than in adjacent bare sediment of similar depth and turbidity within one bay and gear.
evidence_basis: Seagrass cover maps not acquired in this repo.
